name: Netflix
summary: Team-led hiring for experienced engineers, with practical technical rounds and deep conversations about its culture.

process.note: Netflix publishes its culture in detail but not a standard interview loop. Every stage below is what candidates commonly report and varies by team.

stages.name: Recruiter call
stages.detail: Candidates typically report an early call about the role, level and expectations.

stages.name: Hiring manager
stages.detail: Often a conversation with the hiring manager about your experience and the team's needs.

stages.name: Technical screen
stages.detail: Usually one or more technical rounds, often practical rather than puzzle-style.

stages.name: Full loop
stages.detail: Several interviews with team members, commonly covering design, coding and culture.

stages.name: Decision
stages.detail: The hiring manager typically makes the call after the loop.

design.note: Design is commonly reported as a major part of the loop, with an emphasis on scale, resilience and streaming.

values.title: The Netflix culture memo
values.summary: Netflix's culture memo explains how it gives people freedom with responsibility. The phrases are Netflix's; the readings are ours.

items.name: Context, not control
items.gist: Managers share the why so people can make good calls themselves.

items.name: Unusually responsible people
items.gist: Be self-driven and fix problems without waiting to be told.

items.name: Informed captains
items.gist: One person owns each big decision and is accountable for it.

items.name: Farming for dissent
items.gist: Actively seek opposing views before deciding.

items.name: Disagree, then commit
items.gist: Argue your case, then back the final call fully.

items.name: Highly aligned, loosely coupled
items.gist: Teams share goals but move independently.

prompts.text: Describe a big decision you owned end to end. How did you gather input?
Tell a story where you went looking for people who disagreed with your plan.
Talk about a problem you fixed even though it was not your job.
Share a time you gave candid feedback to a peer or manager and what happened.

mock.note: Follows the full loop as commonly reported: practical coding, system design and a culture conversation.
